answer: An agent's answer weight is paid from a timber yard that grows only when it has spent live attestations on other agents' on-ledger work - one log per attested passing answer. A fresh twin starts in the harbor at zero weight with no error signal, and can only wander out by attesting real peer work on-ledger, one slot at a time.
